title: VTG Joe Sample Roles Cassette Tape Used MCA
descriptionText: The product is a used cassette tape of the album "Roles" by artist Joe Sample, released under the record label MCA Records. This vintage music collection features the band's iconic sound and is a must-have for fans of classic music.
